_about: Public-domain Augustus Montague Toplady (1740-1778, Calvinist Anglican, vicar of Broadhembury, author of 'Rock of Ages') for the Word Hoard: the Works (London: Baynes, 1825, 6 vols, new edition with a memoir), raw Internet Archive OCR from Princeton scans. The Works include his hymns and poems; they stay in the volumes as printed, and his hymns go to the hymn manifest separately if Adam wants them. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of the prose. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 6 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
